map.书房/厨房重点照明：提高局部照度（书房 300–500、厨房操作台 500+），: Study/kitchen accent lighting: raise local illuminance (study 300–500, kitchen counter 500+), zone-based configuration.
map.节能替换：已知目标光通量，按 LED 光效（约 80–120 lm/W）反推功率: Energy-saving replacement: given target flux, reverse-compute power by LED efficacy (about 80–120 lm/W), compare with original lamps for savings.

map.照度参考值哪来？: Where do the illuminance reference values come from?
map.取自《建筑照明设计标准》GB 50034 的居住建筑推荐值，因功能而异。: Taken from the residential-building recommended values in the Standard for Lighting Design of Buildings GB 50034, varying by function.
map.用光通量÷光效（LED 约 100 lm/W）得功率；老式荧光/白炽光效低得多。: Power = luminous flux ÷ efficacy (LED about 100 lm/W); old fluorescent/incandescent have much lower efficacy.
map.只算主灯够吗？: Is computing only the main lamp enough?
map.不够，建议分区（基础+重点+氛围），本工具给总量参考，实际按布局细分。: Not enough; zone-based (base + accent + ambient) is recommended. This tool gives a total reference; split by layout in practice.
map.房间照度配置计算器，依据国标照度标准，根据房间面积计算所需光通量、灯具功率与数量: The Room Illumination Calculator, per national illuminance standards, computes required luminous flux, lamp power and count by room area.
